chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Ibn Muskān, from Yazīd ibn Farqad, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: Is sadaqat al-fitrah due upon the needy person? He said: No.

key_terms.الْفِطْرَةِ: the alms of fiṭrah given at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.الْمُحْتَاجِ: the needy person, one in financial need
key_terms.صَدَقَةُ: charitable due; here, the obligatory alms

ai.seo_question: Is sadaqat al-fitrah obligatory on a needy person in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling that sadaqat al-fitrah is not obligatory upon a needy person. It indicates that this financial act of worship is waived from one who is in need or poverty.
